description.value: Swans Liquor Store is the retail bottle shop of the historic Swans complex, a Victoria waterfront institution since 1989 that also encompasses a craft brewery, pub, and boutique hotel. Located at 514 Pandora Ave near the Inner Harbour, the store stocks beer, wine, and spirits including Swans' own range of locally brewed craft lagers, ales, and IPAs. Touring cyclists passing through downtown Victoria can resupply with local BC craft beverages from a well-established neighbourhood landmark.
